Sources — skkugit-demo vendor/cutout
=====================================
Scope: this is a local-only, non-published hackathon prototype. It has
not been distributed, deployed, or made available to any third party as
of the writing of this file. The pins and gates below exist so that, if
that scope ever changes (public repo push counts as distribution once
paired with AGPL-triggering network use — see gate below), the exact
provenance of every runtime artifact is already on record.

Pinned package versions (must match package.json / package-lock.json;
re-check this file if those are ever bumped)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @imgly/background-removal   1.7.0
    npm:    https://www.npmjs.com/package/@imgly/background-removal
    tarball (resolved, from installed package's own metadata):
            https://registry.npmjs.org/@imgly/background-removal/-/background-removal-1.7.0.tgz
    source map (node_modules/@imgly/background-removal/dist/index.mjs.map)
    contains embedded sourcesContent — original TypeScript sources are
    recoverable directly from the installed npm package for AGPL
    source-availability purposes, no separate upstream repo fetch needed.
    License: AGPL-3.0 (vendor/cutout/LICENSE-IMG-LY.txt, copied from the
    installed package's own LICENSE.md).

  onnxruntime-web              1.21.0  (peer dependency of @imgly/
                                        background-removal)
    npm:    https://www.npmjs.com/package/onnxruntime-web
    repo:   https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
    License: MIT, text pinned from the v1.21.0 git tag (see
    LICENSE-ONNX.txt for exact fetch URL and full text).

  esbuild-wasm                 0.25.12  (dev dependency, build-time only —
                                         not shipped to the browser)
    npm:    https://www.npmjs.com/package/esbuild-wasm

  Transitive dependencies of the above (flatbuffers, long,
  onnxruntime-common, platform, protobufjs + @protobufjs/*,
  guid-typescript, lodash-es, ndarray, is-buffer, iota-array, zod,
  @types/node, undici-types): see THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt for the full
  per-package version/license/copyright table. Versions for these are
  whatever package-lock.json currently resolves; re-run `npm ls` against
  the lockfile before treating this file as current if dependencies are
  ever updated.

Self-hosted runtime resources (models + WASM)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
  Origin: https://staticimgly.com/@imgly/background-removal-data/1.7.0/dist/
  (IMG.LY's own CDN for the @imgly/background-removal package's runtime
  assets — this is the official distribution channel documented by the
  package itself, not a third-party mirror.)

  Local copy: vendor/cutout/data/ (CPU model + WASM already downloaded
  into this repo for local/offline use in this prototype).

  Integrity: verified via prepare-cutout.mjs, which reads the pinned
  manifest at vendor/cutout/data/resources.json (a project-local copy,
  content-addressed by SHA256 filename == SHA256 hash of each chunk) and
  either accepts an already-present local file whose SHA256 matches, or
  downloads it fresh from the staticimgly.com origin above and rejects
  it if the SHA256 or byte length doesn't match the pinned entry. Note:
  this pinned manifest is a separate file from, and not the same as,
  node_modules/@imgly/background-removal/dist/resources.json (which was
  empty/`{}` in this install) — the project's own vendor/cutout/data/
  copy is the one actually enforced at download time.

Non-published / local-only prototype scope
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
  This app is not currently published, hosted publicly, or distributed
  to end users. It exists as source + a local dev/build in this
  session's working directory. No relicensing decision has been made:
  the presence of @imgly/background-removal (AGPL-3.0) in this codebase
  does NOT automatically make the surrounding skkugit-demo app AGPL —
  that determination depends on how tightly the two are combined at
  distribution/deployment time, which has not been decided or reviewed.

AGPL-3.0 compliance gate — required BEFORE any distribution or deployment
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
  Do not push this repo to a public GitHub URL that's treated as "the
  product," deploy it to a reachable server, or otherwise let users
  interact with it over a network, until all of the following are
  explicitly reviewed and signed off (not merely because "the repo is
  public" — AGPL's network-use clause is what actually triggers
  obligations, not mere source visibility):
    1. Source availability: confirm the exact corresponding source
       (app source + package-lock.json + build script + the vendor
       model/WASM assets themselves) is what gets offered to any user
       interacting with the deployed service over a network, per AGPL-3.0
       §13. A source zip bundling app source + lockfile + build script +
       vendor model assets is the right shape for this, but has not been
       assembled or published yet.
    2. Compatibility review: confirm no other license in this project
       (or any license the user's own skkugit-demo code is under) is
       incompatible with AGPL-3.0's copyleft terms before combining or
       distributing them together.
    3. Explicit scope decision: decide and document whether the
       AGPL-3.0 obligation is scoped to just the @imgly/background-removal
       component (e.g. isolated as a separable network service) or
       propagates to the whole skkugit-demo app, based on how they are
       actually combined/linked at deploy time — this has not been
       decided here and must not be assumed either way.
    4. Re-verify pinned versions/checksums above are still accurate at
       the time of actual distribution, since dependencies may have
       moved since this file was written.
  None of the above has been completed. This file documents pins and the
  gate itself; it does not constitute compliance sign-off.

Open items for follow-up (not resolved in this pass)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
  - guid-typescript's ISC license lacks a shipped copyright header (see
    THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt Group 4).
  - The "ISNET" model's MIT claim was not independently re-verified
    against https://github.com/xuebinqin/DIS's own LICENSE file.
  - No source-availability zip has been assembled yet; §13 compliance is
    not yet operational, only planned.
